# Vendored whiteboard helpers

whiteboard-core.js — lavish-axi's pure whiteboard helpers (MIT, LICENSE.lavish-axi), built into the pinned frame bundle by script/whiteboard-bundle.ts, with its tests at test/design/whiteboard-core.test.js. Unchanged.

The legacy prototype assets (Tailwind, DaisyUI, Mermaid) live in `legacy/`. The Design app serves them only to authenticated Redcode callers importing pre-0.22 prototypes.
